info.title: E-Control Rate Calculator API Models
info.description: OpenAPI model definitions derived from the E-Control Rate Calculator documentation.

AccountingType.description: Defines accounting types for products and product groups.

CombinationType.description: Represents the types of combination options for Feed-In or Spotmarket Feed-In products.

ConsumptionType.description: Specifies the different types of consumption.

GasGridMeasurementMode.description: Enumerates the supported measurement methods on the gas grid.

PaymentMethodDiscriminator.description: Defines the discriminator values for PaymentMethod Business Objects.

ProductType.description: Specifies the different types of a product.

SmartMeterLoadProfileYearlyData.description: The yearly data of the smart meter load profile.

SmartMeterLoadProfileStateType.description: The state of the smart meter load profile.

RateType.description: Represents different types of rates for a product.

RateZoningType.description: Represents the different types of rate differentiation for a product.

Unit.description: Specifies the different energy unit types.

CustomerGroup.description: Represents different customer groups the rate calculator application is able to calculate ratings for.

DiscountAllowanceType.description: Represents different types of allowances which are considered when discounts are put into account.

DiscountCategoryValidityType.description: Represents the validity for calculation the discount category has.

DiscountRateType.description: Defines the different discount rate types.

DiscountType.description: Defines the type of the discount.

RCSearchMode.description: Defines the search mode of the public rate calculator.

Attachment.description: Represents an attachment of a business object.

BigDecimalRange.description: Represents a range of floating point numbers.

ContractTermProp.description: Business object representing a contract term property, e.g. notice period.

StockExchangeIndex.description: Business object representing a stock exchange index.

ProductBaseRate.description: Represents one base charge of a product.

ProductEnergyRate.description: Represents the business object for one product energy rate.

ProductContractTermInfo.description: Represents a contract term info for a rated product which is displayed in the result list of a rating request.

DiscountDetails.description: Contains details of a discount shown on product details popup opened from a rating result. It contains additional informations to the discounts of the product.

DiscountCategory.description: Business object representing a discount category.

CalculatedDiscount.description: Represents a calculated discount part of a product rating result.

CalculatedFee.description: Represents a calculated fee part of a product rating result. A calculated fee may be common or associated to a specific product.

feeCategory.description: Fee category. The documentation identifies the type as feecategory, but its model definition has not yet been provided.

CalculatedGridCosts.description: Contains detailed information on grid parts of a rated product. All values represented in cent.

ProductRequirement.description: Represents a product requirement ('Voraussetzung') or membership ('Mitgliedschaft').

EnergySourceType.description: Represents a localized energy source type object. Energy source types are the main categories for energy sources.

PowerLabelingEnergySource.description: The mapping between power labellings and energy sources, holding the percentage.

PowerLabelingProducingCountry.description: The mapping between power labellings and producing countries holding the percentage.

BrandContact.description: Representation of a brand contact data.

Product.description: Representation of a product domain entity localized.

Brand.description: Representation of a brand domain entity.

CalculatedProductEnergyCosts.description: Contains detailed information on parts of a rated product. All values represented in cent.

CurrentProductData.description: Data for the current product selection dropdown.

EligibleProductData.description: Drop down line for current product selection.

ContactType.description: This type is used in the database in order to determine what kind of contact the entry represents.

ParameterType.description: Represents different data types a system parameter may be made of.

ProductPropertyType.description: Discriminator column enum for the Product Property Type.

RateUnit.description: Defines the rate unit for a specific rate.

ReferencePeriodOptionType.description: Represents the length of time for the rate calculation.

SmartMeterLoadProfileNormalizationType.description: Specifies the different types of a load profile normalization.

BrandWithSupplier.description: Representation of a brand with supplier information.

CurrentProduct.description: A wrapper object that holds the information about the current user product and brand used as reference when rating products. The brand and product may be provided by the user or retrieved from a specialized REST API that provides a default brand and product for a given grid area, grid operator and zip code.

FeedInRequestOptions.description: Represents the feed-in search object when rating products

PowerSearchValuesRequest.description: Request object to retrieve search values for the advanced power product search, which depend on settings defined here.

ProductComparisionProductRequest.description: Represents a request for product to get the comparison details for the product which are shown on product comparison popup opened from a rating result view.

ProductComparisonDetailsRequest.description: Represents a request for product comparison details which are shown on product comparison popup opened from a rating result view.

ProductDetailsRequest.description: Represents a request for product details which are shown on product details popup opened from a rating result.

RateGasProductsRequest.description: A request to rate GAS products that match the specified search options.

RatePowerProductsRequest.description: A request to rate POWER products that match the specified search options.

SmartMeterDateRange.description: Date ranged of a smart meter value

DayOfWeek.description: The day of the week of a smart meter value.

SmartMeterFeedInRequestOptions.description: Feed in specific Smart Meter request options for the search.

SmartMeterLoadProfileCalculatedValues.description: Calculated values for a loadprofile that will be used instead of the consumption input-field, based on a file-upload.

SmartMeterLoadProfileDetailedValues.description: Detailed values for a loadprofile, based on a file-upload.
